questions.instruction: Classify the type of advertisement based on the company or product being promoted.

options.description: Is the ad promoting a specific food or drink product from a food/drink manufacturing company or brand, directly evidenced by the image or text?
Is the ad promoting a specific food or drink product but created by a non-food brand/company/retailer/service/event?
Is the ad promoting a food or drink manufacturing company or brand without showing a specific product?
Is the ad promoting a specific food or drink product from a retailer?
Is the ad promoting a retailer without featuring a specific food or drink product?
Is the ad promoting a specific food or meal from a restaurant or delivery outlet?
Is the ad promoting a restaurant without showcasing a specific food or meal?
Is the ad promoting a non-food or drink product or service?
Is the ad promoting infant formula or related products?

questions.instruction: Identify all marketing strategies present in the advertisement.

options.description: Characters created or owned by a company representing its brand.

Display of awards or recognitions indicating product quality.
Promotions tied to cultural or seasonal events.
Promotions tied to major sporting events.
